title: Unit 34 Consolidation: Philosophy of Science
goal: I can use the words for tacit knowledge, testing, research ethics, paradigm shifts and the freedom of research.
I can say how sure I am, describe a test with a participle, state a duty, grade a change and state a condition.
I can write one sentence about the freedom of research with *feltéve, hogy* or *kivéve, ha*.
